svg.text: L_(I|O) = ∫ J_red·J_blue ds — evaluated on the same bundle: it picks no paths, it values them

The integrand is the constant exp(−E_J) (E_J = 1, a free parameter of the definition), so the value of a path is exp(−E_J) × its arc length. Drawn: the 698 SM paths of L_SM, each at height exp(−E_J)·s in the same units.
lowest sheet at height e^(−E_J) × arc length (arc length to the tip 0.9404 R)
tip of L_(I|O) at z = 0.9785 (the action W reaches z = 1.2189); E_J is free: the height scales with e^(−E_J)
